terebella.definition: n type genus of Terebellidae; tube-forming marine polychete worms with many filamentous tentacles

terebellidae.translation: [网络] 蛰龙介科；蛰龙介虫科

terebene.definition:
n. A polymeric modification of terpene, obtained as a white
   crystalline camphorlike substance; -- called also camphene. By
   extension, any one of a group of related substances.
terebene.translation:
n. 松节油萜
[化] 特惹烯; 芸香烯; 单萜烯混合物

terebenthene.definition: n. Oil of turpentine. See Turpentine.

terebic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or obtained from, terbenthene (oil of
   turpentine); specifically, designating an acid, C7H10O4, obtained by
   the oxidation of terbenthene with nitric acid, as a white crystalline
   substance.

terebic acid.translation:
[化] 芸香酸; 特惹酸
[医] 芸香酸

terebinth.definition: n a Mediterranean tree yielding Chian turpentine

terebinthina chia.translation: [医] 希沃斯岛松油脂, 笃耨香

terebinthinate.definition:
a. Impregnating with the qualities of turpentine;
   terbinthine.
terebinthinate.translation: a. 松(油)脂的,含松(油)脂的,(气味等)似松(油)脂的

terebinthine.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to turpentine; consisting of
   turpentine, or partaking of its qualities.
terebinthine.translation: a. 松节油的, 松节油的

terebra.definition:
n. A genus of marine gastropods having a long, tapering
   spire. They belong to the Toxoglossa. Called also auger shell.
n. The boring ovipositor of a hymenopterous insect.

terebrant.definition:
a. Boring, or adapted for boring; -- said of certain
   Hymenoptera, as the sawflies.
terebrant.translation:
a. 穿孔的
n. 锥尾虫

terebrantia.definition:
n. pl. A division of Hymenoptera including those which
   have an ovipositor adapted for perforating plants. It includes the
   sawflies.

terebrate.definition: v. t. To perforate; to bore; to pierce.

terebrating.definition:
a. Boring; perforating; -- applied to molluskas which
   form holes in rocks, wood, etc.
a. Boring; piercing; -- applied to certain kinds of pain,
   especially to those of locomotor ataxia.

terebration.definition: n. The act of terebrating, or boring.

terebratula.definition:
n. A genus of brachiopods which includes many living and
   some fossil species. The larger valve has a perforated beak, through
   which projects a short peduncle for attachment. Called also lamp shell.

terebratulid.definition:
n. Any species of Terebratula or allied genera. Used
   also adjectively.
terebratulid.translation:
n. 穿孔贝
a. 穿孔贝科的

teredinid.definition: n wormlike marine bivalve that bores into wooden piers and ships by means of drill-like shells

teredos.translation: n. 蛀船虫( teredo的名词复数 )

terek.translation: [地名] [俄罗斯、吉尔吉斯斯坦] 捷列克河

terence.definition: n. dramatist of ancient Rome (born in Greece) whose comedies were based on works by Menander (190?-159 BC)

terence rattigan.translation: [网络] 泰伦斯·拉提根；编剧；剧作家泰伦斯拉迪瑾

terephthalate.definition: n. A salt of terephthalic acid.
terephthalate.translation: n. 对苯二酸盐；对苯二酸酯

terephthalic.definition:
a. Of, pertaining to, or designating, a dibasic acid of
   the aromatic series, metameric with phthalic acid, and obtained, as a
   tasteless white crystalline powder, by the oxidation of oil of
   turpentine; -- called also paraphthalic acid. Cf. Phthalic.
terephthalic.translation: (=terephthalic acid)[化]对苯二酸, 对酞酸

teres.definition: n. either of two muscles in the shoulder region that move the shoulders and arms

teresa.definition: n. Indian nun and missionary in the Roman Catholic Church (born of Albanian parents in what is now Macedonia); dedicated to helping the poor in India (1910-1997)

teresa of avila.translation: [网络] 阿维拉的特莉莎；亚维拉的德兰；大德兰

teresantalic acid.translation: [化] 对檀香酸; 檀油酸

teresina.translation: 特雷西纳[巴西东北部城市]

teresita.translation: [地名] [厄瓜多尔、哥伦比亚、古巴] 特雷西塔

terete.definition: s especially of plant parts; cylindrical and tapering

tereza.translation: n. (Tereza)人名；(俄)捷列扎；(罗)泰雷扎

terezina.translation: 特雷西纳[巴西东北部城市]
